name: Zero-Trust Supply Chain & Provenance Diode Gate
framework: SLSA v1.0 / Sigstore / npm OIDC Provenance Standard

rules.description: Reject dependencies containing unapproved arbitrary execution lifecycle scripts (preinstall, postinstall, install).
Enforce strict dependency version pinning; reject wildcard or open-range specifications in production manifests.
Block packages mimicking well-known ecosystem libraries (axios, react, express, lodash, trivy, playwright).
Require cryptographic build provenance (SLSA level 2+ or npm provenance) for production runtime modules.
Reject static long-lived publish tokens in automated CI/CD release pipelines.
